original_text: Build Unbound's first-party, evidence-backed, historical charity intelligence system from the broadest feasible lawful external data. No Candid/GuideStar or comparable aggregator is a required runtime, data model, or eligibility decision dependency. Primary sources and direct charity evidence are preferred. External data is not automatically truth; internal knowledge must preserve who claimed what, when, with what evidence and permitted use.
Each stage emits append-only evidence and idempotent, resumable checkpoints. A source failure cannot silently corrupt approved decisions.

Build a control monitoring capability where assurance is computed from expected independent evidence and tested operation, never from the absence of alarms or a self-declared success. This is an enterprise capability serving all DAF business domains, agents, APIs, tenants and external integrations.
1. Governed business APIs emit attributable operational events, never self-asserted effectiveness.
- Risk-weighted coverage is optional and must publish approved weights; never hide raw denominators or high-risk failures behind aggregate scores.

Strata is mandatory as an architectural persistence dependency, but its actual API capabilities have not been independently verified. Require append-only authoritative history, linked corrections, deterministic replay, protected evidence storage, source signing or equivalent integrity, least-privilege access, privacy-safe redaction, legal holds, retention schedules, independent monitoring, tenant isolation and recovery testing. Do not place secrets in general logs. No assumption of a specific Strata cryptographic feature until verified.

ControlCatalog, ControlExpectations, EvidenceIngest, EvidenceQuery, ControlEvaluations, Deficiencies, Remediations, TestPlans, TestExecutions, Attestations, AuditorRequests, AuditPackages, DashboardQueries, WidgetGrants, MonitoringSubscriptions. Read endpoints must enforce sponsor/partner/legal-entity scope. Write commands require idempotency keys, version preconditions, actor authority and complete audit evidence. AI cannot bypass authorization or certify its own results. External webhook subscribers receive minimum necessary event data.

Monitoring failure is a degraded-assurance incident, not a healthy state. If a safety-critical control cannot evaluate, consequential grant/payment/investment actions must follow explicit sponsor-approved fail-closed or manual-continuity policies; never silently continue. Define bounded recovery, escalation, emergency stop and compensating-control requirements before implementation. Live outbound payment execution remains deferred.

Never let a browser, LLM, external partner API or user-provided tenant string choose a database/schema. The broker resolves tenant identity from verified principal + contractual partner/program entitlement and checks the requested fund's owning tenant.

7. Resume traffic, run negative isolation tests, compare balances and monitor. A rollback is a new controlled routing/migration action, never a history rewrite.

Codes below are illustrative templates, not an adopted nonprofit GAAP chart. Account codes SHALL be stable and independent of display names; hierarchical reporting groups may change by version without rewriting history.

Only posted journals are authoritative financial entries. Drafts and approvals are separate append-only business events. Reject negative line amounts, both debit and credit populated on the same line, invalid dimension combinations, unbalanced journals, invalid periods, missing approval or unauthorized posting. Account and dimension referential validity must be checked as of the transaction's policy-effective date.

Important modeling warning: A single journal line must not represent a fund transfer by crediting a cash account without matching fund-specific debits and without a defined accounting-book and dimension-balancing policy. Implement fund allocation as balanced fund subledger entries or paired fund-dimension journals with a zero-net sponsor-wide effect. Similarly, interfund fee charges require explicit consolidated eliminations and approved sponsor accounting policy.
